summary: The exact discrete Duhamel identity (5.10) is incompatible with the repeated smooth-filter scheme (1.6); a fully admissible nonlinear example produces a nonzero two-step residual. Its use in the core convergence proof supports Major. No convergence-rate counterexample is claimed.
limitations: Exact acquired arXiv v3 only; journal-final equivalence not established.
Not all preparatory estimates and stability proofs independently checked.
No claim about novelty or author correction; no author adoption.

problems.title: Repeated smooth filtering is omitted in the discrete propagation identity

source_claim.text: u^(m+n)=P S(n tau)u^m+sum_{k=0}^{n-1}P S((n-k)tau)(N(tau)-I)u^(m+k), while the defined one-step map is P S(tau)N(tau).

assumptions: chi smooth compactly supported in [-2,2], range [0,1], equal 1 on [-1,1]
Nonzero smooth compact Fourier support where 1/4<p(xi)<3/4, p=chi^2((xi^2+1)/lambda)
g=P f; u0=a f in Schwartz; 0<a<=min(1,sqrt(2c/(tau M)))
Actual nonlinear evolution remains epsilon=+1; required H1/H2 regularity and defocusing/subcritical local/global existence regime satisfied

steps: Set B=P S(tau), F=N(tau)-I, unroll u(j+1)=B u(j)+B F(u(j)).
Correct propagation uses B^ell=P^ell S(ell tau).
Actual minus printed two-step expression D2=(P^2-P)S(2tau)N(tau)u0_numerical.
For u0_numerical=a g, ||D2||2>=a c-tau*a^3*M/4, with c>=3||f||2/64.
check.result: Exact formula fails; neither auxiliary stability (5.1) nor failure of fixed-datum convergence is asserted.

counterevidence: P commutes with S; commutation does not imply idempotence.
Correct wider-cutoff identity Pi_(4lambda)Pi_lambda=Pi_lambda at p.35 does not imply P^2=P.
Reinterpreting S_lambda(n tau) as a power contradicts (1.5) and p.5 spectral formula.
Sharp cutoff replacement changes smooth-calculus hypotheses and was not proved valid.

impact.dependency: (5.10) -> (5.11) -> Section5.2 conclusion of Theorem5.1 -> Theorems1.4-1.5; p.33 explicitly reuses both formulas for H1 estimate.
impact.scope: Core derivation invalid; theorem statements and independent spectral results not refuted.

correction.statement: u^(m+n)=B^n u^m+sum B^(n-k)F(u^(m+k)), B^ell=P^ell S(ell tau).
correction.limits: Uniform estimates for repeated-filter propagators and complete convergence proof not established.
